description: This file defines the MainFlutterWindow class, which inherits from NSWindow, setting up the Flutter view controller and registering generated plugins for a macOS Flutter application.

classes.name: MainFlutterWindow
classes.description: A subclass of NSWindow that initializes a FlutterViewController and registers generated plugins during window setup.

methods.name: awakeFromNib
methods.description: Overrides the default awakeFromNib method to set up the Flutter view controller, adjust window frame, and register plugins.
